description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMarch 18, 2026 (DENVER, CO) — The Victor Marx for Governor campaign today announced the submission of more than 28,500 Republican petition signatures to the Colorado Secretary of State's office. This achievement marks a defining moment in the 2026 Republican primary and signals the extraordinary depth of grassroots support behind Marx's bid to become Colorado's next governor.
